nodes.source_conclusion: IsClassicalSolution u₀ H holds iff (1) the real lift (u,r) ↦ H(u⁺, r⁺) is C¹ (ContDiffOn 1) on the closed strip [0,u₀] × [0,∞), with one-sided derivatives at its edges when u₀ > 0; for u₀ = 0 the set is the half-line {0} × [0,∞) and the field is degenerate (recorded constraint ) ("classical" solution of p. 348: a differentiable function whose derivatives are continuous even on r = 0; "C¹[0,u₀]×[0,∞[" of Theorem 1; ); (2) there is one constant C, chosen before u and r, with abs(H(u,r)) ≤ C(1 + r)⁻³ for all u ≤ u₀ and all r ≥ 0 (the field form of "h = O(r⁻³) … uniformly in u" of Theorems 1 and 2, to which it is bridged by the deferred obligation ; implied by the decay of Theorem 3; ); (3) for every u with 0 < u < u₀, every proof hs of IsSlice h for the slice h = H(u,·), and every r > 0, ∂_u H − ½ ḡ ∂_r H = (g − ḡ)(h − h̄)/(2r) at (u,r), i.e. Dh = (1/2r)(g − ḡ)(h − h̄) with D = ∂_u − ½ ḡ ∂_r, (3.13), both partials being deriv of the real lifts . This is the RESTRICTED uniformly-decaying classical-solution class , NOT the most general classical-solution class of [P]; data at u = 0 is not part of the predicate
nodes.constant_scope: C in (2) is existential, depends only on H and u₀, and precedes u and r
